display.title: Zos Chanukah: The Eight Lights and the Clouds of Moshiach
display.summary_short: On the night all eight Chanukah lights shine, Uncle Yossi shares the Rebbe's call to listen to their message: Moshiach will soon gather all Jews home on heavenly clouds.
display.summary_long: A Chanukah talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, recorded on Zos Chanukah, when all eight lights of the menorah are lit. Uncle Yossi recalls the Rebbe's words, in the name of the Frierdiker Rebbe, that we must listen carefully to what the Chanukah lights are telling us. Their message is emunah and bitachon: the King of miracles who did wonders in those days will soon do even greater ones. When Moshiach comes, as the prophet Daniel foretells, heavenly clouds, safer and more comfortable than any airplane, will carry all the Jewish people from the four corners of the world back to Eretz Yisroel, the land promised to Avraham, Yitzchak and Yaakov. Like the eight candles shining together, the Jewish people will be gathered in unity. Uncle Yossi ends with a heartfelt cry of 'Ad mosai, how much longer?', asking Hashem to end the golus and let us see the menorah rekindled in the third Beis HaMikdash.
display.lesson: Listen to the Chanukah lights: trust in Hashem, who will soon bring Moshiach and gather all Jews home.
